## Quarto

Quarto is an open-source scientific and technical publishing system that allows you to create reproducible documents, presentations, websites, and books. It works with multiple programming languages including R, Python, Julia, and Observable JavaScript.

### Installing Quarto

Download and install Quarto from the official website: [https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/)

1. **Windows**: Download the Windows installer (.msi file) and run it
2. **macOS**: Download the macOS installer (.pkg file) and run it
3. **Linux**: Use the provided .deb or .tar.gz packages, or install via package manager
